lead.headline: Argentina sided with the US on 78% of UN votes in 2024-25, up 19 points, biggest rise of 178 countries
lead.number: 59% to 78% in the Sept 2024-Sept 2025 session; the typical country fell 13 points; Argentina ended third most out of step, behind only Israel and the US and level with Russia
lead.watch_out: The session straddles Biden and Trump, so part of the rise may be the US changing its own votes; that split isn't done.

The 10 countries with the highest voting coincidence with the United States were (in descending order, excluding countries that were not allowed to vote during all or most of 2025 due to being in arrears): Israel, Argentina, Madagascar, Sao Tome and Principe, Nauru, and St. Vincent and the Grenadines, South Sudan, Dominica, Kiribati, and Paraguay.
